Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that “Who’s Laughing Now” was released earlier, despite the gathered evidence showing 1990-Sick (Get ’Em All) was released in 1995 and “Who’s Laughing Now” (Ava Max) in 2020—so 1990-Sick is earlier. Even if “Who’s Laughing Now (song)” were interpreted as Jessie J’s 2011 single, it is still later than 1995. This is a comparison/logical error in the final step.
